name: photo-frame-draw-reveal
title: Photo Frame Draw Reveal
description: A photo opens from the centre with a circular clip, then a thin circle, a square outline and a notched decorative border draw themselves around it. Without an image it shows a drawn placeholder scene.
useWhen: A product or place photo needs a framed, drawn-on reveal.
A hero image should open with a circle and gain an ornamental outline.
avoidWhen: Several photos must reveal at once: use product-grid-reveal.
The frame should stay plain and quiet.
author: BlogFire

variables.label: Image URL
variables.description: Optional image URL shown in the frame. Empty shows a drawn placeholder.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Text under the frame. Leave empty for none.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the circle and the decorative border.

variables.label: Outline
variables.description: Colour of the square outline and the circle ring.

variables.label: Border draw time
variables.description: Seconds the decorative border takes to draw.
